notes: Inbound self-serve signup from Aetherline (SMB, ~80 employees). Came through demo page and requested a quick POC for ticket summarization + automated triage. Primary systems: Zendesk (main), Front (secondary), internal CRM sync via structured JSON outputs. Wants hosted Redwood API for speed of integration (no infra). Key asks: tool-calling capability to open/close/route Zendesk tickets, deterministic structured JSON for ticket fields (category, priority, SLA_tag), streaming responses for agent UI, and configurable output schemas so frontend can parse directly. Latency target: initial ack <300ms for agent-facing flows; batch summarization acceptable overnight. Cost sensitivity for token usage — prefer model routing to cheaper variants for low-priority tasks. Security: requires SOC2 report before contract, SAML SSO for admin console, audit logs for agent actions, retention controls (default 90 days) and ability to later add KMS/HSM. GDPR residency for EU customers is a future ask (they have EU customers). POC success criteria: 80%+ summarization accuracy on their eval set (internal), 30% reduction in avg handle time, average cost per ticket <$0.15. Quote from Head of Product Elena Torres: "If we can cut handle time by 20% and keep quality, we'll convert."
